title: Test: verify LOG_WRN emitted on simulated persistence failure in link_ctx
description: After adding LOG_WRN to (void) casts in link_ctx.c (sibling bead), add a test that injects a persistence failure (mock save_tuple returning -EIO) and verifies the warning is logged. Use Zephyr's LOG capture or native_sim log inspection. Verify on native_sim or heft. If not feasible due to mock complexity, document why and close as wontfix.
